concept.hr: A/D pretvarač mjeri signal u razmacima 1/fs i zaokružuje ga na 2ⁿ razina
concept.en: An A/D converter measures a signal every 1/fs and rounds it to 2ⁿ levels

summary.hr: Sinus od 1 Hz digitalizira se s 2 do 1024 uzorka/s i 1 do 16 bitova, a D/A pretvarač vraća stepenasti signal. Pogreška je najviše pola razmaka razina.
summary.en: A 1 Hz sine is digitised at 2 to 1024 samples/s and 1 to 16 bits, and a D/A converter returns a staircase. The error is at most half a level step.

what.hr: Aplet quantisierung_und_sampling.html (skripta: DL9MJ, 2024) i tekst odjeljka o uzorkovanju i kvantizaciji (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet quantisierung_und_sampling.html (script by DL9MJ, 2024) and the text of the sampling and quantisation section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu i nacrtan bez vanjskih biblioteka, preveden na engleski, kvantizator zaokružuje na najbližu od 2ⁿ razina
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit and drawn without outside libraries, translated into English, the quantiser rounds to the nearest of 2ⁿ levels
